responsibility: Implements the SHORTREAL string-formatting module as a thin adapter over ConvStringReal. It owns no independent formatting algorithm; instead it forwards floating-point, engineering, and fixed-point rendering requests for SHORTREAL values to the shared real-formatting routines and returns the resulting DynamicStrings for use by the short-real conversion and I/O layers.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation half of ConvStringShort; unlike the .def declaration file, it contains the executable wrappers that forward all SHORTREAL formatting calls to ConvStringReal.
